english.title: Fail to return licence / badge when disqualified by reason of immigration status from driving hackney carriage
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having become disqualified by reason of your immigration status from driving a hackney carriage, without reasonable excuse, failed within the period of 7 days beginning with the day after the day on which you first became disqualified, to return the licence granted to you under section 8 of the Metropolitan Public Carriage Act 1869, your copy of the licence and your driver's badge to Transport for London
english.legislation: Contrary to section 8A(7) and (8) of the Metropolitan Public Carriage Act 1869.

Summary: A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale and, for a continuing offence, a fine not exceeding £10 for each day during which an offence continues after conviction.
